advisories.title: toml-node: Uncontrolled Recursion
advisories.rationale: Transitive via @stellar/stellar-sdk@12.x (relayer). The only fix is @stellar/stellar-sdk 17.1.0, a major upgrade that renames the SorobanRpc namespace used throughout relayer/src/soroban-delivery.ts; tracked in #887 (#758 is closed; the SDK upgrade is not yet scheduled). toml is not reachable with attacker-controlled input in this codebase.
